column1: # Regression cases for .claude/hooks. Columns (tab-separated): hook, expected exit, tool, input.
# tool: Bash (input = command), Read/Edit/Write (input = file_path), Grep (input = path),
#       GrepGlob (input = Grep glob). A literal \n in the input becomes a newline, \t a tab.
# Absolute paths use the project root /Users/someone/git/mii-fhir-validator (see run.sh).
# Inputs are only passed to the hooks as JSON text; tests/hooks/run.sh never executes them.
